name: Gloomhaven

categories.label: Scenario completed (goal achieved, not lost)
categories.hint: Lost if all characters are exhausted or a scenario loss condition occurs; if both happen in the same round it counts as lost.

categories.label: Scenario level (0-7)
categories.hint: Recommended = average character level / 2, rounded up; may be set freely from 0 to 7.

categories.label: Experience gained (blue dial + completion bonus)
categories.hint: Enter the blue-dial XP, the scenario level and 1 if completed. Completion bonus is 4 + 2 x scenario level.

categories.label: Gold gained from money tokens
categories.hint: Money tokens looted x gold conversion by scenario level (0-1:2, 2-3:3, 4-5:4, 6:5, 7:6). Applies even if the scenario was lost.

categories.label: Battle goal checkmarks earned
categories.hint: Only if the scenario was completed and the goal met; every 3 checkmarks give a perk mark.

categories.label: Masteries achieved this scenario
categories.hint: Each new mastery gives one perk mark; each can be achieved once per character.

winCondition: Party completes the scenario goal given in the scenario rules before all characters are exhausted or a loss condition triggers. Play continues to the end of the round once the end is triggered; completion and loss in the same round counts as a loss.

endCondition.description: Scenario goal reached (completed) or all characters exhausted / loss condition (lost); finish the current round first.

notes: family: coop. No points; campaign progress tracked on the campaign sheet. Completed scenario also gives conclusion rewards (once per campaign), inspiration = 4 - number of characters, and prosperity/reputation per scenario text (not itemised). Lost scenario: characters keep XP, gold and treasure; party may return to Gloomhaven or replay. Solo mode, Frosthaven, Jaws of the Lion not modelled.

sources.title: Gloomhaven 2025 Rulebook (Cephalofair, linked from cephalofair.com/gloomhaven)
sources.section: p.15 Scenario Level / Battle Goals; p.45 Ending a Scenario; p.46 Completed Scenario
